excerpt.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
excerpt.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

texts.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
texts.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

sections.zh:
数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行。

纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终引向了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，当我们准备好步入外面的广阔世界后，我们将一同面对所遭遇的一切。
sections.en:
Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they were also on the cusp of unlocking practical interstellar travel.

A bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and when we were ready to spread out into the cosmos, whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

sections.zh:
数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之而来的，是与两个迥异的外星文明的首次接触。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，但事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，他们感受到了宇宙的召唤，正站在叩响星门的边缘。

纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终促成了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，无论星海中存在着什么，我们都将并肩面对。
sections.en:
Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems - and with them, first contact with two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they felt the pull of the cosmos, and were on the cusp of answering it.

A bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

texts.zh: 尽管我们已经与联盟的其他成员接触了一段时日了，但唯有现在：超光速引擎的实现，让我们这几个帝国可以真真切切地互相接触。现在的问题是，我们的联邦应当专注于什么方面：一些人提倡目前的通用模式，而另一些人则倾向于专注于在特定领域进行更紧密的合作。
texts.en: Though we have for some time been in contact with the other members of our alliance, it is only now - with the invention of FTL drives - that our empires are able to interact with each other on a meaningful level. The question has arisen as to what our federation should focus on: some advocate the current, generalist path, whereas others would favor focusing on closer integration in a particular field.

label.en: The alliance we have is enough.

label.zh: 我们需要在敌人面前保护自己。
label.en: We must defend ourselves against those who oppose us.

label.zh: 只有共同研究才能共同进步。
label.en: Only through research can we progress.

label.zh: 我们当选择凝聚力和传统的道路。
label.en: Unity and traditionalism shall be our path.
Trade is important above all else.
